title: HuBMAP: Embedding Fresh Frozen OCT Samples
author: Marda Jorgensen
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bcwsixee

steps.title: Collect tissue specimen
steps.instruction: Collect the tissue specimen from the designated common coordinate framework sites as indicated in the case processing SOP diagrams.

steps.title: Blot tissue to remove moisture
steps.instruction: Gently blot the tissue piece on dry gauze to remove any excess moisture.

steps.title: Prepare pre‑labeled Cryomold
steps.instruction: Obtain a Cryomold Tissue‑Tek (25 mm × 20 mm × 5 mm, Catalog #25608‑916), label it, and fill it halfway with Tissue‑Tek® O.C.T. Compound (Sakura® Finetek, VWR International, Catalog #25608‑930).

steps.title: Place tissue in Cryomold
steps.instruction: Place the tissue into the OCT‑containing Cryomold, maintaining the desired orientation, and use forceps to push the tissue lightly to the bottom of the Cryomold to secure it.

steps.title: Cover tissue with OCT
steps.instruction: Fill the Cryomold with OCT so that the tissue is completely covered, taking care to avoid bubbles.

steps.title: Prepare dry ice/methylbutane slurry
steps.instruction: Set up a freezing chamber by placing 1–2 inches of dry‑ice pellets into the bottom of an ice bucket or styrofoam box, adding enough 2‑methylbutane to cover the dry ice by ~5 mm, covering with a lid, and allowing the methylbutane to chill until fog dissipates and the bucket bottom becomes visible.

substeps.instruction: Place 1–2 inches of dry‑ice pellets in the bottom of an ice bucket or styrofoam box.
Add 2‑methylbutane solution until it covers the dry ice by roughly 5 mm.
Put the lid on the chamber and wait until the fog clears and the bucket bottom is visible.

steps.title: Freeze the Cryomold
steps.instruction: Using long‑handled forceps, transfer the Cryomold onto the surface of the chilled methylbutane slurry; as the OCT begins to freeze, lightly push the tissue into the bottom of the mold one final time.

steps.title: Wrap and store frozen block
steps.instruction: When the OCT Cryomold is thoroughly frozen and opaque, wrap the mold in a pre‑labeled aluminum‑foil square, store it at –80 °C in a freezer rack box, and record the block location in the freezer log for future retrieval.
